title: Manager, Project Controls Planning (Life Science), Project & Development Services
description:
**Job Title**


Manager, Project Controls Planning (Life Science), Project \& Development Services**Job Description Summary**


Leads planning and scheduling services for large\-scale life sciences capital projects and programs, providing technical leadership, schedule governance, and day\-to\-day oversight of scheduling activities. Responsible for development, maintenance, analysis, and reporting of integrated project schedules that support successful delivery of complex pharmaceutical and biotechnology facilities. Serves as a trusted advisor to project leadership and client stakeholders, providing schedule insights, forecasting, risk analysis, and recovery recommendations throughout the project lifecycle.**Job Description**

**Essential Job Duties:**

* Lead planning and scheduling services for major life sciences capital projects, ensuring alignment of project objectives, milestones, and execution strategies.
* Oversee development, maintenance, and analysis of integrated project schedules encompassing engineering, procurement, construction, equipment delivery, commissioning, and startup activities.
* Provide schedule forecasting, critical path analysis, milestone tracking, and what\-if scenario modeling to support client decision\-making.
* Conduct quality assurance and quality control reviews of project schedules, progress updates, schedule narratives, and forecasting deliverables.
* Coordinate schedule integration across owners, EPCM partners, contractors, equipment vendors, and third\-party stakeholders.
* Monitor schedule performance, emerging risks, and trends, developing mitigation and recovery strategies as needed.
* Mentor scheduling professionals and support staffing, resource planning, and scheduling best practices within project teams.
* Support development and implementation of scheduling standards, processes, and reporting tools.

**Education/Experience/Training:**

* Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration or related field. Master's degree preferred. Certification preferred.
* Ten or more years of progressive planning and scheduling experience, including at least two years of leadership or management responsibility.
* Experience supporting large\-scale capital projects within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, advanced manufacturing, or other highly technical environments.
* Experience supporting major capital projects exceeding $1 billion in total installed cost preferred.
* Advanced expertise in schedule development, critical path methodology, schedule analysis, forecasting, progress measurement, and recovery planning.
* Proven experience developing and managing integrated schedules across engineering, procurement, construction, and vendor organizations.
* Strong client management, consulting, and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Advanced proficiency with Primavera P6 and related scheduling and analytics tools.
* Knowledge of commissioning, qualification, performance qualification (PQ), startup, and operational readiness activities within regulated life sciences environments is highly desirable.
* Exceptional communication, organizational, and analytical skills.

The company will not pay less than minimum wage for this role.  


The compensation for the position is: $ 140,250\.00 \- $165,000\.00

description:

**What We Are Looking For:**


This role is best suited to someone who thrives in a smaller IT environment where they wear multiple hats — leading a team one moment and personally fixing a network issue or supporting an ERP user the next. We are seeking a hands\-on multi\-site IT Manager to lead and personally execute the day\-to\-day technology of our manufacturing operations. This is not a purely administrative or strategy\-only role — the ideal candidate is comfortable rolling up their sleeves to troubleshoot a server issue, configure a switch, resolve a user ticket, or work directly with our ERP system, while also managing a small team, vendor relationships, and long\-term IT planning. **General IT Management**

* Provide end\-user support and training on systems and best practices
* Partner with department leaders to identify technology needs that support manufacturing operations and business growth
* Stay current on emerging technologies relevant to manufacturing and recommend improvements

description:
About Gleason
  
With more than 2,200 employees and 13 manufacturing facilities worldwide, Gleason Corporation is a leader in gear technology. Gleason's product and service offerings include gear and transmission design software, gear manufacturing machines and related accessories, gear metrology equipment and automation systems. Gleason products are used by customers in e\-mobility, commercial vehicles, aerospace, agriculture, mining, sustainable energy, construction, power tools, marine and many other industries

We like working with people who are positive, adaptable and growth\-minded. We care how work gets accomplished and are deeply invested in the success of our customers and colleagues. If this sounds like you, we invite you to read on and learn more.
  
  

Why work at Gleason?
  
* Excellent benefits package including a 6% Company 401(k) match
* Flexible scheduling options available in some departments
* NYS Certified Apprenticeship Program
* Shift premiums for 2nd and 3rd shifts
* Formal and informal development opportunities.


Gleason is seeking Machinists with a wide range of experience for 1st Shift openings
  
  

We offer excellent learning opportunities for candidates just beginning their career in Advanced Manufacturing as well as Precision Machinist jobs for those candidates with the highest level of experience.
  
  

Take a moment to read about Gleason’s Machinist Career Ladder and apply today!
  
  

**Position Summary:**  

Set up and operate a variety of conventional and/or CNC machine tools to produce precision parts and/or instruments by applying knowledge of mechanics, mathematics, metal properties, layout, and machining procedures. Verify product by inspection of precision parts to meet defined print specifications.
  
  

**Machine Tools Include:**  

* Lathe \- turning to .001” tolerance
* Mill \- horizontal \& vertical to .001” tolerance
* CNC Multi\-axis Machining Center to .001” tolerance
* Internal/External Precision Grinding to .0001” tolerance
* CURVIC• Coupling Grinding to .00005” tolerance


**Job Responsibilities, Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:**  

Machinist Level I
  
The Machinist Level I performs machine operations on conventional or CNC machine tools such as lathes, boring mills, milling machines, grinding machines, or shapers:
  
* Read and interpret blueprints, program readouts, and technical directives to determine and obtain materials and cutting tools for the job and to visualize the finished part and critical surfaces, dimensions, and tolerances.
* Complete basic machine set ups.
* Follow detailed instructions concerning the location of necessary dimensions on blueprints, sequence of machine operations, machine feeds and speeds, tools to be used, alignment processes, and predetermined machined dimensions.
* Align parts in the machine according to set methods and given reference points, exercising care to keep material, holding fixtures, and machine stops clear of chips and particles.
* Use knowledge of machine operations to recognize defective tooling, improper coolant flow, the need for changing speeds or feeds, machine malfunctions, or obvious dimensional deviations. Correct the problem by adjusting the machine, cutting tool, or fixture or obtain assistance from a higher level machinist.
* Use measuring instruments such as internal and external micrometers, vernier height and depth gages, indicators, scales, and various standard or preset snap, plug, bore, or ring gages to achieve and maintain critical dimensions and tolerances during the machining process.
* Use measuring instruments to check the accuracy of dimensions and maintain dimensions through the use of fixtures or preset machine stops, depending upon the dimensional tolerances allowed.
* Basic knowledge of trade mathematics including plane geometry and the use of trigonometric functions and machinist handbook formulas.
* Requires supervision, guidance and training as skills are developed.


Machinist Level II
  
The Machinist Level II meets the requirement of a Machinist Level I plus:
  
  

* Operate a wider variety of more complex machine tools.
* Extends the scope of operations on these machines by using various standard machine attachments such as rotary tables, magnetic chucks, gear changing boxes, angular drive heads, taper attachments, and universal milling attachments.
* Intermediate skills in performing precision work on parts that present complex configurations and close tolerances between interrelated surfaces.
* Plan and lay out work from blueprints, work sheets, and drawings that may have missing or incorrect information.
* Operate CNC machine tools when the required manual input includes changes in coolant flow, increases or decreases in speeds and feeds, or stops are programmed for dimensional checks or minor adjustments.
* Edit a CNC program to ensure the part meets the drawing specifications.
* Knowledge of various metals, alloys, and other materials and their machining characteristics that enable them to select the proper cutting tools and determine correct machine feeds and speeds necessary to perform the job.
* Intermediate knowledge of trade mathematics including plane geometry and the use of trigonometric functions and machinist handbook formulas.
* Provide training to Machinist Level I on basic to intermediate machining processes.


Machinist Level III
  
The Machinist Level III meets the requirements of a Machinist Level II plus:
  
  

* Perform a full range of machining operations on most types of conventional or CNC machine tools and their various attachments.
* Has a broad knowledge of various metals that enables the Machinist to produce the desired cuts and finishes on each material.
* Advanced skills in determining work procedures, machine, tools, equipment, and attachments to be used; proper type and size of raw stock; sequence of machining operations, and the speeds and feeds necessary to attain the required finishes and tolerances.
* Setup, operate and debug programs on a variety of CNC machine tools.
* Understand a variety of machine controls and able to make necessary manual inputs to insure accurate dimensional tolerances are achieved.
* Advanced knowledge of trade mathematics including plane geometry and the use of trigonometric functions and machinist handbook formulas.
* Establish needed dimensions such as those required for chasing threads or machining angular surfaces; locating and marking surfaces and angles to be machined, locating reference points, or performing other layout work necessary to facilitate accurate job setups on a variety of conventional or CNC machine tools.
* Manufacture an entire item, carrying out all machining operations necessary for completion, and performing precision handwork such as filing, scraping and lapping to fit, assemble, and finish machined parts.
* Expertise in using many types of advanced precision instruments and equipment such as vernier calipers, height gages, squares, protractors, inside, outside and depth micrometers, surface gages, v\-blocks, parallel bars, gage blocks, dial indicators, optical and mechanical comparators, ring, bore, plug, and go/no\-go thread gages to attain accurate dimensions and maintain tolerances.
* Provide basic, intermediate and advanced training to Machinist Level I and II on most types of machine tools. Can assist others with intermediate to complex machining processes, programming edits and problem solving.


Machinist Level IV
  
The Machinist Level IV meets the requirements of a Machinist Level III plus:
  
  

* Operate conventional or CNC machines in automatic and semiautomatic mode and make logical decisions at each program stop or decision point to manually input, change, adjust, or otherwise complete the machine instructions to produce a quality finished product.
* Highest level of skill in operating multiple machines simultaneously with exceptional quality and productivity.
* Exercise advanced critical thinking skills and ingenuity in selecting and applying tooling and fixturing to maximize quality and productivity.
* Perform machining processes requiring special adaption of equipment or processes for which they were not specifically designed.
* Use special or improvised tools, fixtures, and setups to machine unusual surface configurations such as curved surfaces requiring machine feeds in different planes simultaneously; surfaces having closely interrelated dimensions; or surfaces having unusual or compound angular relationships.
* Skilled in programming machining operations, setting up and operating CNC machine tools;
* Read existing CNC programs line by line during the machining operation to predict and correct potential process failures before they occur resulting in a machine collision and damage to machine tooling or part.
* Recommend changes to CNC machine tool programs on deficiencies noted; and to coordinate directly with the parts programmer or toolmaker.
* Critique part designs and make recommendations for design modifications to part features.
* Advanced knowledge of software, machining sequence, processing time, inspection requirements and operations of CNC machines to help engineering personnel develop software to complement equipment specifications and procurement (i.e., machine tools, flexible machining systems, robots, and automated inspection equipment).
* Expertise in the selection of metrology equipment and its proper use to ensure the most repeatable results are achieved.
* Thorough knowledge of advanced shop mathematics. They have skill in using geometry and trigonometric formulas to compute compound angles, angular indexing, hole patterns, pitch lead, and pitch diameters for various standard and non\-standard threads.
* Skill in performing work assignments requiring untried tasks or procedures such as machining rare metals, or new metal alloys. This requires determining the best tooling material, tool types, coolants, and machine feeds and speeds to use in various machining operation; or independent interpretation and translation of work orders, drawings, and specifications frequently requiring computing and establishing missing tolerances, dimensions, and types of fits and finishes.
* Machinists Level IV apply a knowledge of the effect and relationship of heat treating, annealing, plating, welding, and other related work processes on various machining operations in completing an assignment.
* Subject matter expert in a broad spectrum of machine tools.
* Provide training and assist others with the most complex machining processes, programming edits and problem solving. Act as mentor and coach to other team members and shares knowledge, advice and assistance with all team members.


**All Machinists are required to:**  

* Have basic computer skills; knowledge of Microsoft Word and Excel is a plus.
* Meet daily/weekly production targets.
* Comply with all company policies, procedures and practices
* Follow all department processes/procedures through consistent application of sound quality assurance principles.
* Work cooperatively with all team members.
* Multi\-task and engage in work related activities to maximize productivity.
* Be willing to learn and participate in operations and development of equipment within the cell.
* Actively participate in Continuous Improvement initiatives and 5\-S projects to support improved operations and cost reduction.
* Participate in activities related to improvement in Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) by contributing ideas to reduce scrap and rework.
* Willingness to work overtime and different shifts as needed to meet productivity requirements and customer expectations.


**Preferred Education/Training/Experience:**  

* High school diploma or equivalent required

description:
Overview:
**About This Role**
===================


Avita Care Solutions is rebuilding how technology gets into the hands of the people who deliver patient care, and we are looking for the person who will own that from end to end. This is a genuinely greenfield role. We have executive sponsorship, a newly approved procurement and asset management policy, a service management platform implementation underway, and a defined improvement program. What we need is an operations leader to run it.  

As the **Manager of IT Procurement and Asset Management**, you will own IT procurement, Avita’s IT warehouse, asset lifecycle management, and secure asset disposition for a multi\-site healthcare organization. You will hold our resellers and disposition partners accountable to their contracts, decide what gets sourced from stock versus bought new, and make sure every device that leaves our environment is accounted for. Along the way you will help shape the automation that replaces the manual work this function runs on today.  

This is a hands\-on, working\-manager position based at our AvitaCare Atlanta clinic facility. You will spend time on the warehouse floor, not only in dashboards and vendor calls. If that combination of operational ownership and physical work appeals to you, read on.**Why Avita**
=============


Avita Care Solutions provides pharmacy and clinical services to communities that are too often underserved by the healthcare system. The equipment you source, stage, and deploy is what our pharmacists and clinicians use to take care of patients. When a pharmacy goes down, care stops. Operations work here has a direct line to patient impact, and the people doing it are treated accordingly.**What You Will Own**
=====================

* **Procurement and sourcing**. Decide stock versus buy on every request, place and manage orders with our value\-added resellers, and hold those partners to their committed pricing and lead times. Maintain the equipment standards catalog and guide new vendors through our legal, security, and finance review before any purchase order is issued.
* **Avita’s IT warehouse.** Run daily operations end to end: receiving, staging, storage, stock rotation, check\-in and check\-out control, imaging and testing throughput, and outbound shipping to our sites. Set and manage minimum and maximum stock levels so we stop running out of the things people need.
* **Asset lifecycle and data integrity.** Serve as steward of our IT asset management system, the system of record for every device, its state, its location, and its custody history. Run reconciliation audits, chase down discrepancies, and keep the data trustworthy enough that Finance and Security can rely on it.
* Secure asset disposition. Own the disposition process for retired equipment, including routing, pickup logistics, and chain\-of\-custody documentation. Hold our disposition partner to its contractual destruction\-certificate timeline and escalate when it slips. In a healthcare environment this is a compliance obligation, not paperwork.
* **Vendor and partner management.** Manage the working relationship with our resellers, our disposition vendor, and our onsite field\-services partner. Run quarterly performance scorecards, validate invoices against orders and receipts, and resolve discrepancies before we pay them.
* **Process ownership and improvement**. Publish the performance dashboard for procurement, assets, and disposition. Partner with our IT leadership and platform implementation team on the configuration of the service management platform, the asset system, and the workflow automation connecting them. Charter and deliver improvement work every quarter, and actively eliminate manual steps rather than absorbing them.
* **Team and budget.** Supervise a small Atlanta\-based warehouse and asset support team. Contribute inventory forecasts and lifecycle replacement projections to annual IT budget planning, and report monthly on spend against plan.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================


We measure this function, and we will be straightforward with you about how. Targets phase in as our platform implementation lands rather than applying on day one.* First 90 days. Learn the environment, take ownership of the vendor relationships, establish reliable baseline measurement for cycle time, inventory accuracy, and destruction\-certificate capture, and identify the three biggest sources of delay.
* Six months. Warehouse processing consistently meets its three\-business\-day turnaround. Destruction certificates are captured and reconciled on time, every time. Stockouts of standard equipment have stopped. Vendor scorecards are running.
* Twelve months. Steady\-state performance against the published program: on\-time fulfillment at 95 percent or better, asset\-record accuracy at 98 percent or better, complete destruction\-certificate capture, spend within 5 percent of plan, and meaningfully fewer hand\-offs per request than we have today.

title: 26-27 Director of Food and Nutrition Services
description:
**Position Summary:**


The Director of Food \& Nutrition Services provides strategic and operational leadership for the Somerville Public Schools Food \& Nutrition Services Department, ensuring that students have consistent access to high\-quality, nutritious, appealing, and culturally responsive meals.

  

The Director is responsible for the effective administration of all district food service operations, including school breakfast and lunch programs, afterschool and summer meal programs, financial management, procurement, menu planning, food production and distribution, regulatory compliance, staffing, and customer service. The Director leads the department as a financially responsible and service\-oriented operation while ensuring compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local requirements.


The Director works collaboratively with school leaders, district departments, city partners, families, students, and community stakeholders to continuously improve the quality, accessibility, efficiency, and responsiveness of the district's food and nutrition programs.

 **Essential Functions \& Responsibilities**

*The responsibilities listed below reflect the primary duties of the position; the omission of specific statements of duties does not exclude them from the role. Additional responsibilities that are similar, related, or a logical assignment to the position may be assigned as needed to meet program, legal, or operational needs.*

 **Strategic Leadership \& Continuous Improvement**

* Provide districtwide leadership and strategic direction for all Food \& Nutrition Services programs and operations.
* Lead the continuous improvement of district food and nutrition services, with a focus on meal quality, student participation, equitable access, operational efficiency, and the student and family experience.
* Use participation, financial, operational, student feedback, and other relevant data to monitor performance, identify trends and challenges, and inform department priorities and resource allocation.
* Maintain current knowledge of developments and best practices in school nutrition, food safety, procurement, food preparation, equipment, technology, and program administration.
* Serves on the district Wellness Committee and has a role in the development, implementation, monitoring, and evaluation of the Wellness Policy. Relatedly, this role is required to provide updates around school nutrition requirements and FNS initiatives to the broader district team.
* Represent Somerville Public Schools with relevant government agencies, vendors, professional organizations, community partners, and other stakeholders.

 **Program \& Operational Management**

* Administer the district's school meal programs, including breakfast, lunch, afterschool snack and meal programs, summer food service, and other district\-sponsored nutrition programs.
* Develop, implement, and continuously improve menus that meet nutritional standards while considering student preferences, cultural responsiveness, dietary needs, food quality, cost, and operational feasibility.
* Oversee food production, preparation, transportation, distribution, and service systems across all district schools and programs.
* Establish and monitor standards for food quality, portioning, presentation, customer service, sanitation, and overall cafeteria operations.
* Develop and maintain clear operating procedures, performance expectations, and accountability systems to ensure consistent, high\-quality food service operations across all district schools.
* Oversee planning for the purchase, maintenance, replacement, and appropriate use of food service equipment, vehicles, technology, and other department assets.
* Develop and maintain contingency and continuity plans to ensure reliable meal service during staffing shortages, facility disruptions, equipment failures, emergencies, or other operational challenges.
* Develop and oversee FNS marketing and communications in coordination with district communications.

 **Financial Management, Procurement \& Resource Stewardship**

* Establish and maintain effective financial\-management systems, including annual budget development, forecasting, expenditure monitoring, revenue management, and financial reporting.
* Manage the Food \& Nutrition Services program to support long\-term financial sustainability while maintaining high standards for meal quality and student service.
* Lead purchasing, procurement, inventory control, bid development, vendor selection, contract management, and monitoring of food, supplies, equipment, and related services.
* Ensure procurement and contracting practices comply with applicable federal, state, municipal, and district requirements.
* Identify and pursue grants, reimbursements, and other external funding opportunities that support district nutrition programs and oversee implementation and reporting for awarded funds.

 **Compliance, Food Safety \& Accountability**

* Ensure districtwide compliance with all applicable USDA, Massachusetts Department of Elementary and Secondary Education, Department of Public Health, City, and other federal and state requirements governing school nutrition programs.
* Lead department compliance, monitoring, documentation, reporting, audits, and corrective\-action processes.
* Oversee food safety and sanitation systems, including HACCP records, required certifications, food\-handling procedures, equipment protocols, and staff training.
* Develop and maintain systems for accurate meal counts, production records, inventory records, financial records, and other documentation required for program management and reimbursement.
* Maintain appropriate confidentiality regarding personnel, financial, operational, and student information.
* Oversight of medically necessary meal modifications, food allergies, 504/disability accommodations, and collaboration with Nursing and Student Services to make sure there are consistent procedures across the district.

 **Staff Leadership \& Development**

* Recruit, supervise, develop, and evaluate Food \& Nutrition Services staff, including the Assistant Director, managers, lead staff, and other department personnel, in accordance with district policies and applicable collective bargaining agreements. employee relations, performance management, grievances, collective bargaining agreement interpretation, and working with HR and union representatives.
* Establish effective staffing models and schedules across district kitchens and cafeterias based on enrollment, meal participation, production requirements, and operational needs.
* Provide ongoing training and professional development to Food \& Nutrition Services employees on food preparation, sanitation, equipment use, customer service, regulatory requirements, and department procedures.
* Establish clear expectations, systems of accountability, and structures for communication and coordination across the Food \& Nutrition Services team.

 **Student, Family \& School Partnership**

* Develop strategies to increase student participation in district meal programs and improve the overall student and family experience with Food \& Nutrition Services.
* Establish and maintain clear systems for timely communication and response to students, families, school leaders, and staff, including processes for addressing meal programs, menus, dietary needs, service concerns, and operational issues.
* Collaborate with school and district leaders to identify and resolve operational issues affecting food service delivery and the student experience.
* Build effective partnerships across schools and district departments to ensure Food \& Nutrition Services programs are responsive to student and school needs.

 **Other Responsibilities**

* Perform other duties consistent with the scope and responsibility of the position as assigned.

 **Knowledge, Abilities, \& Skills**

* Deep knowledge of school food service operations, large\-scale food production, and institutional meal programs;
* Knowledge of federal and Massachusetts school nutrition requirements, including USDA child nutrition programs;
* Strong knowledge of food safety, sanitation, HACCP procedures, and applicable health regulations;
* Strong financial\-management skills, including budgeting, forecasting, cost control, revenue management, and financial analysis;
* Knowledge of public procurement, purchasing, inventory management, contracts, and vendor management;
* Ability to lead and supervise a large, distributed workforce across multiple school locations;
* Ability to establish clear operating systems, performance expectations, and accountability structures;
* Ability to use financial, participation, operational, and customer\-service data to monitor performance and drive continuous improvement;
* Strong project\-management and organizational skills, including the ability to coordinate multiple priorities, timelines, locations, and stakeholders;
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and customer\-service skills;
* Demonstrated ability to respond effectively and professionally to concerns raised by students, families, staff, and school leaders;
* Ability to collaborate effectively across schools, district departments, City agencies, vendors, and community partners;
* Knowledge of food service management technology and proficiency with standard workplace technology, including Google Workspace and/or Microsoft Office;
* Ability to communicate in multiple languages preferred; and
* Commitment to equitable access to nutritious, high\-quality meals and student\-centered service.

 **Physical Requirements**


The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the position’s essential functions.

* **Physical Strength Requirements:** Moderate – lift, carry, push, or pull 20\-50 lbs
* **Posture \& Movement Requirements:** Frequent standing and walking; ability to visit kitchens, cafeterias, storage areas, loading areas, and other food service environments throughout the district.
* **Sensory Requirements:** Ability to perceive written information; inspect food preparation and service environments; hear and understand verbal instructions; and communicate clearly with staff and stakeholders.

 **Qualifications \& Requirements**

* Minimum of five years of progressively responsible experience in food service, nutrition services, hospitality, or a related operational environment required;
* Demonstrated experience supervising large\-scale or multi\-site food production and service operations required;
* Demonstrated experience managing budgets, procurement, purchasing, and operational systems required;

* Knowledge of USDA school nutrition programs and applicable federal and state regulations strongly preferred;
* Current food protection/safety/sanitation certification required, or ability to obtain required certification within a timeframe established by the district;
* Registered Dietitian, School Nutrition Specialist, Certified School Nutrition Director, or comparable professional credential preferred;
* Experience managing and developing a diverse workforce strongly preferred; and
* Experience serving students and families in a diverse urban community preferred

**Job Summary**
---------------

To support our extraordinary teams who build great products and contribute to our growth, we're looking to add a **Director of Materials, Supply Chain and Logistics** located in **Milpitas, California** .  



  

Report to **General Manager** , the **Director of Materials** , **Supply Chain and Logistics** is responsible for leading and executing end\-to\-end materials management, supply chain, procurement, planning, warehouse, logistics, and production control strategies supporting manufacturing operations across the United States and Mexico. This role ensures material availability, supply chain resilience, inventory optimization, operational excellence, and customer satisfaction while supporting business growth and profitability.
  

The Director leads a geographically dispersed organization responsible for procurement, strategic sourcing, inventory management, logistics, warehouse operations, production planning, document control, and New Product Introduction (NPI) support. This position closely with Operations, Engineering, Quality, Finance, Program Management, and customers to drive supply chain performance, cost optimization, and successful product lifecycle execution.  



  

**What a Typical Day Looks Like**

* Drive material availability, inventory optimization, working capital improvements, and supply chain risk mitigation strategies.
* Manage strategic sourcing, supplier development, contract negotiations, and cost reduction initiatives across U.S. and Mexico operations.
* Oversee production planning, demand management, capacity planning, and S\&OP processes to align customer demand with manufacturing capabilities.

*

**About** **Company**


Mizuho OSI is the leader in the markets for specialty surgery and patient positioning. The company’s portfolio includes specialty surgical tables for procedure\-specific approaches that improve patient outcomes in spine and orthopedic surgeries along with disposable and reusable surgical patient care products.

  

**Job Summary**


The **Account Manager** is responsible for generating, closing sales, and providing support across one of Mizuho OSI’s core business portfolios. This role owns the commercial success of the assigned portfolio and product lines servicing hospitals, ambulatory surgery centers, and physicians in a specifically defined geographic territory. The position must consistently sell across the assigned portfolio and meet sales quota established by senior management.


* **Consumables**, including surgical consumables and disposables product category.
* **Spine,** including capital equipment and consumables with the following product lines:
	+ ProAxis,
	+ Trios,
	+ Levo, and
	+ Retirement and migration from legacy platforms

**Responsibilities:**


Based on the assigned portfolio and their product lines, the **Account Manager** responsibilities include but are not limited to:


* Gain market knowledge and maintain awareness of procedures, new technologies, and techniques to develop sales approach. Maintain awareness, compile, and communicate competitive information on equipment and devices preferred by the marketplace.
* Develop professional relationships within the healthcare community in assigned territory with physicians, hospital management, procurement and clinical personnel. Evaluate customer’s needs and emphasize salable product features, using technical knowledge of capabilities and limitations of current product offering.
* Proactively identify new business opportunities, maintaining a funnel visible in Salesforce.com, or the applicable technology. Document precisely what future sales orders will occur.
* Negotiate terms of sale including pricing and special features with administrative and multi\-specialty clinical personnel.
* Educate and train customers on Mizuho OSI products. Provide pre and post\-sale product demonstrations, customer product in\-services and clinical support. Attend surgical cases to support staff in the use of Mizuho OSI products and equipment as necessary. Adhere to specific hospital protocols and procedures.
* Advise customers of equipment for a given need based on technical knowledge of the market procedures and products.
* Utilize the “Trust Triangle” and sales tools throughout the sales process. Maintain sales activity reports as required by RM and through the use of the company\-provided CRM program; update the system a minimum of once per day on the status of pending sales opportunities and other pertinent customer account information.
* Represent Mizuho OSI products at tradeshows and courses when requested to do so.
* Develop and maintain good relationships with partner roles within the Company.
* Provide Sales coverage for vacant Sales territories when requested to do so.
* Provide training and instruct other Account Managers and members of the department and the company, by passing along skills and information to assist then in their development.
* Maintain a company issued cell phone and portable computer in order to conduct business. Participate in the company provided vehicle program.
* Complete and submit accurate expense reports to document activity and expenditures in a timely manner according to the Expense Policy.
* Become an independent employee able to analyze problems and formulate plans to overcome challenges and to get work done quickly with a high degree of quality. To make sound and logical decisions and choose the appropriate courses of action based on the parameters of the situation at hand and to use continual improvement problem solving skills.
* Create an ongoing effort to improve the Company through personal action and by contributing ideas to support both the Department and Company’s ongoing improvement efforts.
* Understand, follow and support Mizuho OSI’s internal Quality System policies, procedures and work instructions including but not limited to applicable external regulations (21 Code of Federal Regulations Part 820 Quality System Regulations and applicable International Standards).
* Understand Mizuho OSI’s business objectives and the relationship between the Department and those objectives; to support and follow the Corporate Vision, Mission \& Values Statements, to maintain the services and quality levels set by Mizuho OSI, and to continually enable Mizuho OSI to be a great place to work.

**Qualifications \& Requirements:**


* Bachelor’s degree in business administration or related field; three (3\) to five (5\) years of selling experience in the medical marketplace, device/capital equipment preferred; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Excellent computer skills including Windows based operating system using various office equipment and machines, and telephone system. Ability to efficiently and effectively use Microsoft Office365 including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams.
* Working knowledge of Salesforce.com or similar CRM is preferred.
* Mechanical aptitude and ability to learn anatomy, physiology and medical terminology.
* Excellent customer focus with a high sense of urgency. Ability to successfully execute professional interpersonal and communication skills.
* Ability to clearly express oneself verbally in the English language (additional languages also preferred) using good grammar, vocabulary, eye contact, and friendly voice inflection with all employees. Ability to communicate effectively with employees and other business contacts in a courteous and professional manner. Persuasive and expositive skills are also required.
* Neat and professional appearance and outgoing people\-oriented personality which conveys pride in working for Mizuho OSI and which is demonstrated with a ready smile and a willingness to assist others.
* Ability to function calmly in a fast\-paced environment managing multiple priorities simultaneously. To be able to positively manage situations of a dynamic nature; to be able to modify plans, actions, and decisions in light of changing situations and circumstances while still meeting, or proposing modified, deadlines. In addition, critical thinking and negotiation skills are required.
* Ability to clearly and effectively express oneself through written means, to properly use such technical factors as grammar, punctuation, vocabulary, and correct spelling. To be able to prepare business letters, memorandums, and reports. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, strong presentation, project and organizational skills.
* Ability to effectively make formal and informal product presentations to individuals as well as to large groups, including physicians, RNs, OR staff, Hospital Supply Chain, and Hospital Executives.
* Ability to perform basic arithmetic functions, create and reconcile reports, demonstrate strong analytical skills, and attention to detail.
* Able to respond sensitively to the needs and feelings of others regardless of position; to accept interpersonal differences, to maintain rapport, and to interact effectively with all levels of employees within the organization.
* Able to demonstrate an understanding, and the regular use of a time management process, which systematically structures one’s own work to provide for effective task performance, territory management, and to plan and prioritize items to meet future demands.
* Ability to establish and accomplish goals independently and to function as a positive and productive team member.
* Knowledge of the Trust Triangle sales process preferred.
* Ability to function in an operating room environment and attend surgical procedures as necessary.
* Must live within 20 miles driving distance of assigned territory.
* Must have a valid driver’s license and qualify for company’s auto insurance policy.
* Must be able to travel extensively about 50 to 75% within the U.S and Canada, and cover the business travel expenses, and submit reimbursements in accordance with company policy.

Team Members will be required to follow any other job\-related instructions and to perform any other job\-related duties/functions requested by their People Leader.**
